name: Cyclindole
summary: Ciclindole, also known as cyclindole (USANTooltip United States Adopted Name), is an antipsychotic of the tetrahydrocarbazolamine family with a tricyclic cyclized tryptamine structure that was never marketed.

pharmacology.text: It displaces spiperone binding in vitro and elevates dopamine levels in the striatum, indicating that it acts as a dopamine D2 receptor antagonist.

uses.text: Ciclindole (INN; developmental code name WIN-27,147-2), also known as cyclindole (USAN), is an antipsychotic of the tetrahydrocarbazolamine family with a tricyclic cyclized tryptamine structure that was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. Antipsychotics in general can cause drowsiness, dizziness, weight gain and movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness, and rarely neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。一般來說，抗精神病藥可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、體重增加，以及僵硬、顫抖、坐立不安等動作問題，少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。一般来说，抗精神病药可能造成嗜睡、头晕、体重增加，以及僵硬、颤抖、坐立不安等动作问题，少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: The WIN in its code name marks compounds from the American company Sterling-Winthrop. Its shape is a tryptamine bent back on itself and locked into an extra ring.
fact.zh: 代號中的 WIN 表示這是美國史特林溫斯羅普公司的化合物。它的結構就像一個彎折回來、被鎖進額外環中的色胺。
fact.zhHans: 代号中的 WIN 表示这是美国史特林温斯罗普公司的化合物。它的结构就像一个弯折回来、被锁进额外环中的色胺。
